table inet trafficctl_mon {
	set bytes_in {
		type ipv4_addr
		size 65535
		flags dynamic
	}

	set bytes_out {
		type ipv4_addr
		size 65535
		flags dynamic
	}

	chain mon_forward {
		type filter hook forward priority -200; policy accept;
		update @bytes_in { ip daddr counter }
		update @bytes_out { ip saddr counter }
	}
}
